project_info.name: Sapa Food - Editorial Vietnamese Restaurant & CMS
project_info.stack: React.js + Tailwind CSS + FastAPI + MongoDB + Shadcn UI
project_info.design_archetype: ARCHETYPE 1: ORGANIC & EARTHY / EDITORIAL RETRO-LUXURY (Dishoom & Bao London inspired)

design_principles.1_fusion_over_imitation: Blends Indochine warmth, vintage European editorial typography, and Hanoi street food soul into a tactile paper-and-lacquer aesthetic.
design_principles.2_emotion_first: Evokes nostalgia, rich aromas, and welcoming hospitality through warm cream tones, lacquer red accents, organic paper grain, and cinematic hero video.
design_principles.3_content_is_king: Presents Vietnamese gastronomy like a literary journal—clear bilingual dish names, allergen details, daily specials, and authentic food photography.
design_principles.4_mobile_first_utility: Designed primarily for phone users in central Prague with a sticky bottom action bar (Menu, Zavolat, Objednat) and an ultra-frictionless mobile CMS for the owner.
design_principles.5_contrast_and_breathing_room: Generous vertical rhythm, subtle borders, asymmetric bento photo grids, and strong typographic contrast.

display_serif_headline.usage: Main headings (H1, H2), hero title, daily menu headline, section storytelling titles

body_sans.usage: Body narrative, dish descriptions, allergen lists, contact info, form fields

utility_mono.usage: Prices ('239 Kč'), allergen numbers (1–14), badge codes, operating hours tags, admin item counters

scale.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight
scale.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-semibold tracking-snug
scale.caption_label: text-xs sm:text-sm uppercase tracking-widest font-mono text-amber-900/70 dark:text-amber-200/70

color_palette.theme_mode: Light-first warm paper aesthetic with dark mode support for evening atmosphere

cream_paper_bg.usage: Primary page background, light cards, editorial sections

warm_beige_surface.usage: Card surfaces, sticky category nav background, modal backdrops

deep_lacquer_red.usage: Primary brand color, primary CTAs ('Objednat přes Wolt', 'Uložit'), active category tabs, key badges

tamarind_brown.usage: Primary text headings, dark borders, footer background, primary emphasis

turmeric_gold_accent.usage: Highlight badges, 'Dnešní menu' star tag, daily price emphasis, star rating icons

dark_herb_green.usage: Vegetarian & Vegan badges, fresh herb highlights, opening hours open tag

grid_modes.bento_asymmetric: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 sm:gap-8 (Hero image span-8, daily teaser span-4, narrative story span-7, gallery span-5)

1_hero_section.description: Full-viewport video hero with fallback image poster, subtle dark gradient overlay (bg-black/45), headline in Fraunces serif, bilingual tagline, and immediate action CTAs.

2_sticky_mobile_bottom_bar.description: Fixed bottom bar on mobile screens (block md:hidden) with quick action buttons for high conversion.
2_sticky_mobile_bottom_bar.classes: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 bg-[#F4EDE2]/95 backdrop-blur-md border-t border-[#3E2319]/15 p-2 px-4 flex items-center justify-between shadow-2xl md:hidden

3_sticky_menu_category_nav.description: Horizontal scrollable pill menu anchored to the top when scrolling through dish categories.
3_sticky_menu_category_nav.classes: sticky top-16 z-40 bg-[#FBF8F2]/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#3E2319]/10 py-3 px-4 flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar

4_dish_card.structure: Image (real PNG product dish photo on clean bg), Vietnamese Name (bold serif), Czech/English Description, Price in JetBrains Mono, Allergen badges (1-14), Veg/Vegan tag (Dark Herb Green badge), Variants select dropdown or radio chips (e.g. A. Krevety 239 Kč / B. Hovězí 229 Kč).
4_dish_card.allergens_legend: Full modal or expandable drawer showing 1–14 EU allergens standard code definitions.

5_daily_menu_page.header: Dnešní menu (Today's Menu) with current date formatted in CZ ('Pondělí 12. května'), banner notice 'Podáváme do 14:00'.
5_daily_menu_page.empty_state: Warm paper styled empty state card with 'Dnešní menu připravujeme...' and link to regular menu when no daily items are active for today.

6_contact_page.elements: Interactive Google Maps iframe embedded in styled dark frame, complete opening hours matrix with live 'Právě otevřeno / Zavřeno' badge, telephone, email, address in Praha 1, delivery links (Wolt, Foodora).

7_admin_cms.mobile_optimized: Designed specifically for non-technical owner operating from a smartphone.
features: Login with credentials & change password screen
Daily Menu Editor: Date selector, item builder, 'Kopírovat z minulého dne' button, publish/unpublish toggle

Regular Menu Editor: Category CRUD & drag/order, item CRUD with Vietnamese/CZ/EN text, price, photo upload, allergen multi-select (1-14 checkboxes), veg/vegan badges, visible toggle, variant matrix builder

media_assets.food_photos_rule: MUST use real product dish photos from local files/site assets. NO generic AI stock dish images for specific menu items.

background_textures.description: Subtle light brown recycled paper texture for section background overlays

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements, buttons, nav tabs, forms, admin controls, language switchers, and menu item cards MUST include explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Inject Google Font import for 'Fraunces', 'DM Sans', and 'JetBrains Mono' into index.html or top of App.js/CSS.
Configure custom tailwind colors inside tailwind.config.js for cream background, lacquer red, tamarind brown, turmeric gold, and dark herb green.
Ensure CSS scroll-reveal and transitions strictly respect prefers-reduced-motion media query.
Make sure all React components are written in standard JS (.js / .jsx). Do not use TS/TSX files.
Build the Admin interface with ultra-large touch targets (min 48px height) so the owner can seamlessly manage the menu from a mobile browser.
